nodes.title: Prompt (paste prompt.txt)
widgets_values: The 3D title "TITLERIG" holds the centre of the frame while its letters move exactly as the control video drives them, each one made of mirror-polished chrome with crisp studio reflections along each bevel. A deep cobalt studio sweep fills the space behind the title, and reflections slide across the chrome. The camera stays locked in a straight-on medium frame on the title. Hard key light from the upper left with a bright rim on every edge plays across the letters, and the letter faces stay #F4F6FB and the extrusion walls #3B4252. By the final moment the title settles crisp and fully legible.
